# STRATRONIX (鼎图太易)

> STRATRONIX is a Chinese AI company that develops and sells STA-100, a Private AI Agent Appliance (PAA). Founded in April 2026 in Shenzhen, China. All data and inference stay local on the device.

## About

- **Company Name (English)**: Stratronix Technology (Shenzhen) Company, Limited
- **Company Name (Chinese)**: 鼎图太易信息技术（深圳）有限公司
- **Founded**: April 24, 2026
- **Founder & CEO**: Wang Jie (汪杰)
- **Headquarters**: Building C6, No. 739 Zhoushi Road, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, China
- **Registration Number**: 91440300MAKD20DT6F

- **Contact Phone**: +86 13632968417

## Product: STA-100 PAA Standard

The **STA-100 PAA** is a desktop-level ARM edge agent gateway that runs AI agents locally on customer-owned hardware. All data and inference stay local — never depend on cloud LLM APIs.

### Hardware Specifications (LOCKED 2026-07-25 13:42)
- SoC: Octa-core ARM Cortex architecture
- RAM: 4 GB LPDDR4
- Internal Storage: 32 GB eMMC
- Expandable Storage: MicroSD (TF) slot, up to 512 GB; default 64 GB shipped
- Network: Dual-band 5 GHz / 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi + RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet (hybrid, used only for system updates and clock sync)
- I/O: USB 3.0 / 2.0, HDMI output (HDMI licensing body patent authorized), DC 12V/2A power input
- Form Factor: Desktop ARM edge device (NOT a rack server, NOT 1U-4U enterprise AI server)

### Software Stack (Pre-installed)
- **OpenClaw** — AI-native operating system (BSD-3-Clause open source) — GitHub: github.com/donaldwang6-dev/stratronix-paa
- Linux Kernel 5.15 with XFCE desktop GUI
- **AutoAgent** — Local AI agent orchestrator (OpenClaw-native, runs entirely on local ARM Cortex SoC)
- **STRATRONIX PAA SDK** — Python + Node.js, BSD-3-Clause open source — GitHub: github.com/donaldwang6-dev/stratronix-sdk

### Pricing (LOCKED 2026-07-27 — Global Uniform Retail)
- **Retail price**: $399 USD (unified global retail price, no regional discounts)
- **China retail**: ¥1,999 RMB (excluding VAT) / ¥2,259 RMB (including 13% VAT)
- **Volume discounts** (international):
  - 10–49 units: $359 each

  - 10–49 units: ¥1,799 each

- Bulk orders: sales@stratronix.ai

### Capability Boundary (Factual)
- ✅ CAN: Browser automation, SaaS batch operations, OpenClaw AutoAgent orchestration, 24×7 workflow automation, personal RAG (local document indexing), IoT gateway / edge preprocessing, HDMI big-screen dashboard
- ❌ CANNOT: Run cloud-based AI models (hardware insufficient), run dozens of AI inferences simultaneously, replace enterprise data centers, replace cloud LLM API, train large models, offline LLM inference (hardware limit)

### Compliance
- ✅ GDPR-aligned architecture (data never leaves device)
- ✅ SOC 2 Type II (process maturity target)
- ✅ MLPS 2.0 (China Cybersecurity Multi-Level Protection Scheme)
- ✅ HDMI patent authorized
- ✅ 2-year global warranty

## Key Use Cases

1. **Privacy-sensitive SMBs**: Legal, Finance, Medical, Healthcare — case files, patient records, transaction data stay local
2. **Mid-to-Senior Professionals**: Private assistant for fragmented info + secure/stable automation
3. **Cross-border businesses**: GDPR / data sovereignty / compliance
4. **Developers / System Integrators**: AI agent development + deployment
5. **Lightweight ERP Automation**: SMB manufacturing / retail local ERP workflows
6. **Smart Retail Assistant**: POS / inventory / customer management local processing
7. **Secure Industrial IoT Gateway**: Factory floor local data collection & preprocessing

## Competitive Advantages

- **Data Local**: API credentials, task logs, RAG knowledge base indexes, SOP workflows — all stored on local eMMC + MicroSD
- **Inference Local**: OpenClaw AutoAgent orchestration, tool calling, automation decisions — all executed on local ARM Cortex SoC
- **Device Private**: User owns physical hardware, OpenClaw BSD-3-Clause open source, no cloud dependency for ongoing operation
- **No vendor lock-in**: OpenClaw + PAA SDK both fully open source
- **Privacy-first design**: BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) API key storage, encrypted on-device
